mapper.sql: id, schedule_uuid, policy_id, dispatch_type, target_filter::text AS target_filter, scheduled_at, channels, template_id, priority, status, created_by, created_at, started_at, completed_at
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_dispatch_schedule SET status = #{status}, started_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PROCESSING' AND started_at IS NULL THEN now() ELSE started_at END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'FAILED') THEN now() ELSE completed_at END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notification_dispatch_schedule WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND scheduled_at <= now() ORDER BY priority DESC, scheduled_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_dispatch_schedule SET status = 'PROCESSING', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, now()) WHERE id = #{id}
